summary: The kickoff meeting introduced a new remote‑control project with a target selling price of €25, a profit goal of €50 million and an international market focus. The team reviewed the project phases and tools, and each member was assigned to start work on design, technical functions and user requirements. No concrete decisions on the remote’s type were made, and further market research was identified as needed. The meeting ended with plans for follow‑up sessions and email distribution of information.
discussion_points: Discussion of project finances (price, profit, market)
